# Logical Constraint

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:LogicalConstraint`](gmeow-LogicalConstraint.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/LogicalConstraint>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A boolean combination of constraints under a [`gmeow:constraintLogic`](../properties/gmeow-constraintLogic.md) operator ([odrl:and](http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/and) / [odrl:or](http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/or) / [odrl:xone](http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/xone) / [odrl:andSequence](http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/andSequence)) over its [`gmeow:logicConstraintMember`](../properties/gmeow-logicConstraintMember.md) constraints — the ODRL [`LogicalConstraint`](gmeow-LogicalConstraint.md), modelling the deontic constraint logic.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to combine two or more constraints under a boolean operator — AND (all), OR (any), XONE (exactly one), or AND-sequence (ordered) — the ODRL [`LogicalConstraint`](gmeow-LogicalConstraint.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid for a single comparison (use [`gmeow:AtomicConstraint`](gmeow-AtomicConstraint.md)) and avoid mixing the logic operator into the member constraints; the operator is [`gmeow:constraintLogic`](../properties/gmeow-constraintLogic.md) on the logical constraint itself.

### How to use

- Mint one [`LogicalConstraint`](gmeow-LogicalConstraint.md), set [`gmeow:constraintLogic`](../properties/gmeow-constraintLogic.md) to the boolean operator, add its parts with [`gmeow:logicConstraintMember`](../properties/gmeow-logicConstraintMember.md) (each itself an Atomic or Logical constraint), and attach it to a rule with [`gmeow:ruleConstraint`](../properties/gmeow-ruleConstraint.md).

### Examples

- ex:euAndUntil2030 a [`gmeow:LogicalConstraint`](gmeow-LogicalConstraint.md); [`gmeow:constraintLogic`](../properties/gmeow-constraintLogic.md) [`gmeow:logicAnd`](../individuals/gmeow-logicAnd.md); [`gmeow:logicConstraintMember`](../properties/gmeow-logicConstraintMember.md) ex:inEu, ex:until2030.
